summary: 10월부터 이듬해 3월까지 강과 하구, 해안, 간척지에서 볼 수 있는 겨울철새로, 해마다 수천 마리가 겨울을 나고 이동 시기에는 수만 마리가 지나간다. 주로 재갈매기를 비롯한 다른 갈매기 무리에 섞여 지낸다. 물고기와 게, 물속 곤충 등을 먹는다.

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 수컷이 조금 크다.

young: 첫겨울 어린새는 머리와 아랫면이 일찍 희어져 뒷목의 짙은 줄무늬가 두드러지고, 등과 어깨깃은 회색·흰색·검은색이 섞인 비늘무늬이며 셋째날개깃은 검은 바탕에 흰 테가 넓다. 날 때 허리가 희고 꼬리 끝의 검은 띠가 좁으며 안쪽 첫째날개깃이 옅고, 부리는 검거나 기부가 분홍색이다.

similar.how: 머리와 목에 갈색 줄무늬가 없고, 등과 날개덮깃이 재갈매기보다 진한 회색이다.

art.subject: Caspian Gull (Larus cachinnans), Korean wintering form Mongolian Gull (L. c. mongolicus), adult in winter (October–March): head and neck white with at most a few fine grey streaks on the hindneck, much cleaner than Vega Gull; back and upperwing coverts medium grey; wingtip black with white mirrors and white primary tips; white tertial and scapular crescents; underparts and tail white. Bill stout, yellow, with a red spot near the tip of the lower mandible. Pale iris with a bright red orbital ring. Legs pale flesh-pink.
art.pose: standing among a mixed flock of gulls on a mudflat
art.scene: Korean winter: estuary mudflat at a river mouth with a mixed gull flock; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing: clean white head and neck with almost no streaking, medium-grey back and wing coverts, black wingtips with white spots, white body, yellow bill with a red spot, pale pink legs
adult, head detail in profile: unstreaked white head, pale iris, red orbital ring, deep yellow bill with a red spot near the tip of the lower mandible
art.build: Large, heavy-bodied gull, about the size of Vega Gull and much larger than Common Gull or Black-tailed Gull; long-winged, with a strong neck and a fairly long, deep yellow bill with a marked angle on the lower mandible. Legs medium-long, pale pink. At rest the black primaries project well beyond the white tail. In flight medium-grey upperwing with a white trailing edge and a black wingtip with white mirrors. Tail square, all white in adults.
avoid: Do not cover the head and neck with heavy brown streaks — that is winter Vega Gull; this form stays white-headed.
Do not paint a dark slate-grey back — that is Slaty-backed Gull (Larus schistisagus).
Do not paint a black tail band or a black-and-red bill tip (Black-tailed Gull).
Do not paint a small slim bill or greenish legs (Common Gull).
